    Twisted linearizations #

    For scalars λ(l, l') ∈ kˣ on pairs of paths of Q_P with the same nonzero value, the twisted linearization k^λ(P) is kQ_P modulo the zero paths and the relations l = λ(l, l') l' (Gabriel–Roiter 13.9, in contour form). If λ(l, l') = a(l)/a(l') for a function a on the arrows, rescaling the arrows gives k^λ(P) ≅ k(P) (RayQuiver.twistedLinEquiv).
